payload.artist_html: G. F. Funston, T. W. Dudgeon, D. J. Simon, D. M. Dufault, C. Boyd, D. Fowler, P. J. Currie & D. C. Evans
payload.credit_html: Supplementary Materials for: "Fruit-eating adaptations in a Late Cretaceous oviraptorosaur (Theropoda)"
payload.description_html: Neck and body blocks of the holotype of Infernogallus jamesi. Photograph (a) and line drawing (b) of neck block of ROM VP 65050, extending from cervical vertebra 5 to the scapulacoracoid. Photograph (c) and line drawing (d) of body block, extending from dorsal vertebra 5 to the acetabulum of the pelvis. Abbreviations: cor, coracoid; c6, cervical vertebra 6; c12, cervical vertebra 12; cd1–3, cervicodorsal vertebrae 1 to 3; d9, dorsal vertebra 9; furc, furcula; gas, gastralia; hum, humerus; il, ilia; l.fem, left femur; l.pub, left pubis; l.tib, left tibia; r.fem, right femur; sr, sternal ribs; st, sternal plate; scap, scapula. Scale bar as indicated.
